kill-fixture.scope: Explicit KillSingle fixture capture only; it is not ordinary lethal damage.

limits: Exact native fishA01 / enFishA / renderer 121695 source assignment only; no fishA02, fishA03, sibling chassis, material route, or topology receives credit from this record.
The ordinary no-focus hit reduced health from 58 to 48; death used the explicit KillSingle fixture and is not ordinary lethal-damage evidence.
Eighteen selected original PNGs were reviewed; the remaining 342 captured frames and generated videos are retained evidence but were not individually reviewed.

The fixture drives the native Death animation through a connected launch and coherent ragdoll collapse, with the custom corpse still sampled behind the loot overlay; it does not establish ordinary lethal behavior or corpse lifetime after the sampled interval.

The causal Damaged and Death impact frames are strongly occluded by the foreground hero and bright effects; recovery and collapse remain readable, and no sampled separation, tearing, missing surface, floor clipping, or viewport clipping was observed.

Indirect death, other native attack variants, portrait, collision, extended culling, long-session resource lifetime, full campaign completion, and final art-direction approval remain outside this archive.
